lines.say: Why do you sleep through your alarm?
Put the alarm across the room.

lines.cap: YOU WALK OVER,|SWITCH IT OFF,|*CRAWL BACK.
lines.say: You walk over, switch it off, crawl back.

lines.cap: SO MAKE THE BED|*TIP YOU OUT.
lines.say: So make the bed tip you out.
You land in the wardrobe. Ouch.
So add a trampoline to catch you.
You bounce right out of the window.
Now you're stuck upside down for hours.

lines.cap: SO TIP A *BUCKET|OF WATER ON YOU.
lines.say: So tip a bucket of water on you.
It's freezing. And your bed is wet.

lines.cap: SO SLEEP IN A *BOAT.|NOTHING GETS WET.
lines.say: So sleep in a boat. Nothing gets wet.

lines.cap: THEN THE *RAIN CAME,|AND YOU FLOATED AWAY.
lines.say: Then it rained and you floated away.
You wake up, right on time.
